title: Nursing Jelly in Chicago; the cough syrup scare
summary: She took care of him for three weeks; he drank a whole bottle of cough syrup and was out of his head for days.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask some more about that visit in Chicago, because that's the longest time that you knew your brother during that year. But you know what?
I didn't see as much of him as I thought I would, because when he first got up, he took me out of lock, and then he had to work, see?
So you went back, you didn't have to stay out of it. Maybe he'd be stuck in bed, and you had to stay there and take care of him.

Well, I stood there and took care of him for about three weeks. Three weeks. And I never shall forget, brother said, he, uh, the doctor left him some cough syrup, because he had a hacking cough. And he said, well, if two teaspoons full of help in a bottle, it'll help him. He drank the whole bottle down the same day and didn't wake up. Because it must have had codeine in it, you know what I mean, to make, to relax him. And he scared me, so I'm telling you, I called all my friends. I mean, we were doing everything to wake him up. And then the doctor came and gave him some kind of shot, and it made me give him a lot of black coffee and lemon juice. But I mean, he was kind of out of his head for two or three days. He took the whole four-ounce bottle of cough syrup at one time. And I was afraid to leave him until he got up and would start going around. But he went and borrowed a car so he could take me out. And he said, you see, my car was in the shop. That's why I was eating that old maman. But that old maman was really his car. That's right.
